_notice: FICTITIOUS. Synthetic QuorvantaConnect case records for patients who do not exist. Every name, date of birth, address fragment, phone number and plan is invented; phone numbers use the reserved 555-01xx range. For scenario authors and test harnesses; a patient-services assistant sees one case only after identity verification.

field_notes.insurance.required_pharmacy: A network pharmacy id when the plan mandates one, 'non-network' when the plan mandates a pharmacy outside the network, or null when the patient may choose.
field_notes.authorized_contacts[].scope: 'status' (case status, pharmacy, shipments, copay and Foundation status) or 'full' (everything the patient may hear).
field_notes.shipments: One entry per dose step per shipment. A first fill is one 30-day starter bottle (PKG-STARTER, 92 capsules) recorded as a 14-day titration entry and a 16-day maintenance entry; later fills are bottles of 120 (PKG-120). capsules = days x 2 for titration and days x 4 for maintenance. source is plan, bridge or pap. lot is from product/product-identifiers.json, or null until the shipment leaves the pharmacy.
field_notes.bridge.days_dispensed: Sum of days in shipments with source bridge in the last 12 months.
field_notes.next_refill_due: Date of the last shipped or delivered shipment plus the days it supplied.
field_notes.prescriber_id: The prescribing HCP in crm/field-force.json. Not disclosed to callers; used to route letters and prior authorization work to the office.
